> Design Operations Leader & AI Workflow Architect. Design leader with 25 years designing enterprise products across healthcare, financial services, telecom, and technology. Founder of Winzinvest and Casimir Systems. Based in Wheat Ridge, CO. Canonical facts: https://winzenburg.com/about

## Identity

- Legal name: Ryan Winzenburg
- Role: Design Operations Leader & AI Workflow Architect
- Location: Wheat Ridge, CO, United States
- Experience: 25 years designing enterprise products across healthcare, financial services, telecom, and technology (Comcast, CVS Health, Life Time Fitness, and others).
- Organization: Ryan Winzenburg (ProfessionalService) — Design operations leadership, AI workflow architecture, design systems, and UX consulting.

## Ventures

- [Winzinvest](https://winzinvest.com): Founder. Rules-based trade execution software for RIAs, wealth managers, family offices, and self-directed traders.
- [Casimir Systems](https://casimirsystems.com): Founder & Principal Investigator. Defense technology company building AI-powered decision-support software for U.S. Department of Defense and Space Force / SpaceWERX missions.

## Flagship writing (information gain)

- [AI Isn't a Feature. It's a Workflow Problem.](https://winzenburg.com/articles/ai-isnt-a-feature-workflow): Core thesis: durable AI advantage comes from workflow redesign, not feature bolt-ons.
- [Why Most Design Systems Fail (And How to Fix Them)](https://winzenburg.com/articles/design-systems-fail): Organizational failure modes of design systems and AI-powered fixes from firsthand enterprise work.
- [The Agent Layer Is Becoming the Business Layer](https://winzenburg.com/articles/the-agent-layer-is-becoming-the-business-layer): Agent design as org design — ownership, authority, and operating boundaries.
- [How I Built an Enterprise Design System in 4 Weeks (Not 12 Months)](https://winzenburg.com/articles/design-system-4-weeks): First-person build story with concrete delivery outcomes.
- [The AI-Powered Design Tech Stack](https://winzenburg.com/articles/ai-tech-stack): Practitioner stack for AI-augmented design operations.
